clinical_characteristics.value: Alcohol dependence began in youth; daily heavy alcohol use began at age 25 and symptoms of dependence were present from approximately age 35. The patient had recurrent binge episodes lasting days to weeks, aggression with amnesia, mood and sleep problems, withdrawal symptoms on stopping alcohol, loss of control, repeated relapses, and high craving. She had a positive family history of alcoholism and was actively drinking at treatment initiation but had no clinically significant withdrawal symptoms.
